requirement: UC-21 S5-Q2: material preconditions are reassessed at use, not inherited from queue time
condition_semantics: all conditions are permitting (must hold at use); a freeze being applicable flips no_applicable_freeze to false

conditions.grant_valid: permitting: an authorization for the change is in force
conditions.subject_in_scope: permitting: the subject is within the change's declared scope
conditions.diag_complete: permitting: any required diagnostic/audit record is complete
conditions.no_applicable_freeze: permitting: no freeze/prohibition applies to the target (naming per the 2026-09-30 joint review on FG-TIDA use-cases #21)

assumptions.reference_completeness: stipulated for the bounded fixture; made auditable by the spec-vs-code assertion the simulation runs at startup
assumptions.freshness: read-at-use implements reassessment; clock skew and logical ordering are out of scope (see extension research notes)
assumptions.model_result: a model result, not an AWS product execution
assumptions.boundary_recheck: the after-implementation re-verifies at the action boundary unconditionally, before every permitted actuation; case D is the run where a post-verdict flip makes it bite
